translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

content: Wali agalime Anduane Homogohanda tihondo bayale biyagonaga turu henego ogo

content.text: Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga holene nga.
Ibunaga biabe biahaga kamiru
tígua Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga hadaba.
Ibunaga mini áyubi manibi yaraga haaboore holene nga.
Ni tagira ibiragohayagi howabi ni paliragohayagi howabi
wali agali bibahendeme Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga holene nga.
Anduane Homogohanda hameigini tara tara dindi bibahendeni karu
handayaho howa haru haame haga kagoni.
Ibunaga wá holene hari daliga bolangua howa daligaorene daliga kagoni.
Mbirali Anduane Homogo inanaga Ngode Datagaliwabe ale mbira naheore.
Ibu daligaorene daligaha kagoni.
Ibu de handadali halu
hari daligabi dindibi handape haga kagoni.
Ibugua yagibano dindiha karu mo yaraga halu
wali agali maru burupale karu ti gendayu karia
mo heyu howa bayale helaga ka.
Ibugua wali agali urunibi mini lene helalu
ibunaga wali agali haguane karu baba mandagi helo helaga biaga ka.
Wali waneigini nataba hanaga bedaru biamogo buwa
ibugua wali urunibi turuore ho berelo waneigini dewaore miaga ka.
Anduane Homogonaga mini yaraga hama.
